timezone: Trip dates are local Las Vegas dates (Pacific Time).
preferredWindow: Feb 15–18, 2027 (3 nights, as stated in the brief)
costBasis: 7-night stays (the brief asks for 7-night totals). 3-night price is shown separately where captured.

legend.v: Verified — read directly on an official page during this session (2026-11-27), or by a prior logged session on the stated date. Source link on the row.
legend.p: Partial — an official page confirms part of the claim only.
legend.u: Unverified — left blank. No official source confirmed it; see Flagged for Review.

rules: A value is shown only when an official source (hotel, restaurant, venue, transit agency, or the official Las Vegas MICHELIN list) states it.
Dynamic booking prices are snapshots. Every nightly rate was captured live on the date shown and will change.
No tax-inclusive total is computed anywhere. Booking engines display rates 'excluding taxes'; the tax amount is not published in the captured output, so it is left unstated.
Travel times are not modelled or estimated as facts. Where no official journey time was retrieved, the cell says so.
Michelin tiers follow the official 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest list published on visitlasvegas.com. 2027 awards have not been announced.
keyFindings: The 2026 Las Vegas MICHELIN list has 24 distinctions: 4 starred (5 stars total), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended.
Las Vegas has no subway/metro. Rail service is the 7-station Las Vegas Monorail plus RTC buses and the Deuce.

Every MICHELIN restaurant in Las Vegas is within the Strip/Downtown/Chinatown core; a 1-hour bus/rail filter therefore does not separate Strip hotels. Michelin restaurants inside the same resort is the filter that does.
The Venetian/Palazzo campus has four MICHELIN distinctions — the densest cluster — but its dated rate calendar returned no prices.
Cheapest verified 7-night total for a two-queen room: Flamingo Las Vegas, $581 including its $50/day resort fee, taxes excluded (captured 2026-11-27 for Feb 15–22, 2027).

South Point is the only property whose own engine posted a full 7-night total with fees for three different date windows: Feb 15–22 ($919 king / $989 two queens), Feb 22–Mar 1 ($979 / $1,049) and Mar 15–22 (no availability on Mar 20, 2027).
